summary: Verified CI fix for GitHub Actions. Simulated exact CI environment: backend started with env -i on port 8097 (no .env, no EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, no STRIPE keys), DB_NAME=turismo_ci_agent_verify, ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD=admin123. Ran all 3 test files (test_pst_affiliation.py, test_bloque_d.py, test_bloque_c_payments.py) => 49/49 tests PASSED. Confirmed test_bloque_c_payments.py does NOT reference /api/pst/documents/upload anywhere. Confirmed workflow .github/workflows/tests.yml has: (a) 'Start backend' step exits 1 after 30s timeout, (b) 'Dump backend logs on failure' step with if: failure().
critical_code_review_comments: Workflow env block correctly sets DB_NAME globally so both backend process and test process share it. Verified: without matching DB_NAME between backend and test process, test_payment_status_ownership_403 returns 404 (as test inserts into a different DB than backend queries). Real CI does not have this issue because env: at workflow scope propagates to all steps.
test_credentials: Admin: admin/admin123 (ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD=admin123). PST users created dynamically per test with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: None - tests self-seed with unique TEST_ prefixed identifiers per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CI simulation verified. Backend runs fine without EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (storage init succeeds, uploads would fail but no test hits real upload anymore). To reproduce CI locally: pkill any 8097 backend, then start with env -i PATH=$PATH MONGO_URL=... DB_NAME=turismo_ci_agent_verify JWT_SECRET=... CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD=admin123 uvicorn on port 8097, and run pytest with SAME DB_NAME env exported so both processes agree on DB.

verifications_performed.workflow_exit_1_on_timeout: Confirmed in .github/workflows/tests.yml Start backend step: 'echo ERROR ... exit 1' after 30 retries
verifications_performed.workflow_failure_log_dump: Confirmed: 'Dump backend logs on failure' step with 'if: failure()' present
verifications_performed.all_49_pass_ci_env: 49 passed in 4.87s with clean env, port 8097, fresh DB
